def build(p):
    # Outer body: 45-degree lower taper from boss_od at z=0 to knob_od, then cylindrical grip rim
    taper_h = (p.knob_od - p.boss_od) / 2.0
    cone = cq.Solid.makeCone(p.boss_od / 2.0, p.knob_od / 2.0, taper_h)
    upper = cq.Solid.makeCylinder(
        p.knob_od / 2.0,
        p.knob_h - taper_h,
        cq.Vector(0, 0, taper_h),
    )
    body = cq.Workplane("XY").newObject([cone.fuse(upper)])

    # Scalloped finger-grip flutes around the perimeter
    flute_pts = [
        (
            p.flute_offset * math.cos(2.0 * math.pi * i / int(p.lobe_count)),
            p.flute_offset * math.sin(2.0 * math.pi * i / int(p.lobe_count)),
        )
        for i in range(int(p.lobe_count))
    ]
    flutes = (
        cq.Workplane("XY")
        .pushPoints(flute_pts)
        .circle(p.flute_r)
        .extrude(p.knob_h)
    )
    body = body.cut(flutes)

    # Through-hole for the M5 bolt shaft
    bolt_hole = (
        cq.Workplane("XY")
        .circle(p.bolt_clearance_d / 2.0)
        .extrude(p.knob_h)
    )
    body = body.cut(bolt_hole)

    # Blind hex nut pocket from z = floor_t to z = knob_h
    af_pocket = p.nut_af + p.nut_pocket_clearance
    hex_circum_d = af_pocket / math.cos(math.pi / 6.0)
    pocket_depth = p.knob_h - p.floor_t
    hex_pocket = (
        cq.Workplane("XY")
        .workplane(offset=p.floor_t)
        .polygon(6, hex_circum_d)
        .extrude(pocket_depth)
    )
    body = body.cut(hex_pocket)

    return body

def build(p):
    n_pockets = 5
    length = n_pockets * p.coupon_pitch
    coupon = (
        cq.Workplane("XY")
        .box(length, p.coupon_w, p.coupon_h, centered=(True, True, False))
    )
    pocket_depth = p.coupon_h - p.coupon_floor_t
    for i in range(n_pockets):
        x = (i - (n_pockets - 1) / 2.0) * p.coupon_pitch
        af = p.nut_af + (i - 1) * p.coupon_step
        hex_circum_d = af / math.cos(math.pi / 6.0)
        hole = (
            cq.Workplane("XY")
            .center(x, 0)
            .circle(p.bolt_clearance_d / 2.0)
            .extrude(p.coupon_h)
        )

            .workplane(offset=p.coupon_floor_t)
            .center(x, 0)
            .polygon(6, hex_circum_d)
            .extrude(pocket_depth)
        )
        coupon = coupon.cut(hole).cut(pocket)
    return coupon
